topic.title: Text Deleted Against Text Modified
topic.shortdesc: User A removes text that user B edits. The conflict must be reported at the granularity of the removed fragment, not of the whole block.

section.title: Troubleshooting
section.p: The service writes an audit record for every login. The record contains the client IP address and the user agent. Records are rotated daily.
Collect the audit archive before opening a ticket.
Attach the metrics bundle and the thread dump to the ticket.

ul.li: Check that the signing key is readable by the service account.
Check that port 8443 is reachable from the load balancer.

row.entry: Counted per client identifier and per tenant.
